March 6, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers 
Cambridge Financial Group Inc increased its stake in Apple (AAPL) by 1.34% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cambridge Financial Group Inc bought 515 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 38,962 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $6.00 billion, up from 38,447 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
